rows.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
rows.answer:
The Get Smart costs more and does more. It's R$ 129,90/month, against R$ 79,90/month for the Get Clássica [prod-ofertas-maquininha-11][prod-todas-as-maquininhas-04].

The Get Smart is a smart card machine that runs Android. It works as both a computer and a fiscal printer. On the device you can:
- manage stock
- take orders
- close the bill
- load a menu
- issue fiscal receipts
- exchange messages between kitchen and floor
- reconcile payments in all methods

Sources: [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-17][sup-duvidas-get-smart-08].

The sources don't describe the Get Clássica's features, so I can't compare the two feature by feature. I can pass you to a human agent if you want more detail.

Arquivos Get Smart - Getnet: O que é a Get Smart?
O que é a Get Smart?
A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. Você pode controlar o estoque, fazer pedidos, fechar conta, embarcar cardápio, emitir nota fiscal, tudo diretamente na máquina. A Get Smart permite que você integre o terminal com o sistema de seu estabelecimento e assim terá todos os aparelhos que seu negócio precisa em um único lugar.

Arquivos Get Smart - Getnet: Quais os diferenciais de uma Get Smart?
Quais os diferenciais de uma Get Smart?
Com um sistema de gestão integrado ele permite que não tenha a necessidade de deslocamento para consultar um estoque, o mesmo pode ser consultado diretamente na máquina. Ele permite um balcão mais limpo, onde não é necessário ter um computador e uma impressora fiscal, ele faz ambas funções. Ele permite mais rapidez no atendimento diminuindo o tempo de espera do cliente, você pode fazer o pedido, fechar a conta e emitir o cupom fiscal tudo diretamente no terminal. Com ele você tem uma conciliação com pagamentos em todas modalidades, crédito, debito, crediário, QR Code ou dinheiro. Os sistemas de gestão homologados possuem conciliação completa.

Getnet | Maquininha de cartão: Melhores taxas e opções grátisMaquininha de cartão: Melhores taxas e opções grátis: Get Clássica: R$ 79,90/mês
Get Smart: R$ 129,90/mês
Para fins desta oferta, o Faturamento é valor bruto das transações liquidadas no mês, processadas nas maquininhas Get Clássica e Get Smart, incluindo transações via Pix capturadas nos equipamentos. Não entram no cálculo do Faturamento operações de Recarga, Voucher, valores estornados ou cancelados até a data de corte:

[policy:capabilities] Capabilities and action policy of this assistant (generated from the system's tool registry):
- Lookups the assistant runs immediately, only on the authenticated customer's data: get_settlements (Agenda de depósitos das vendas aprovadas do cliente autenticado: datas de depósito (dia útil), totais e contagens já calculados.); get_transactions (Vendas e recusas do cliente autenticado, com o significado do código de recusa, contagens e totais calculados.); get_terminal_status (Terminais do cliente autenticado: conexão, sinal, último contato e há quanto tempo está offline.).
- Actions the assistant can PROPOSE; nothing runs until the customer confirms the proposal: open_support_ticket (Abre chamado técnico para um terminal do cliente. Exige confirmação.).
- High-risk actions: they need the customer's confirmation AND then the approval of a human agent (operator) before they run: request_receivables_advance (Solicita antecipação dos recebíveis agendados. Exige confirmação do cliente e aprovação de um atendente.).
- An action proposal that is not confirmed expires after 15 minutes.
- Hand the case to a human agent: opens a case with a ticket number; the agent's reply shows up in this same conversation.
- A decision on an individual case (dispute, block or release of a held amount) belongs to a human agent; the assistant does not decide it.
- Apart from these tools, the assistant does not carry out any action in the system.
- Identifiers the lookups accept: transaction_id = Id da transação (ex.: TX1007) (ex.: TX0000); terminal_id = Id do terminal (ex.: T1988A) (ex.: T0000A).
- Values the lookups and actions accept (closed list: no other value is accepted): get_settlements — period (padrão yesterday): yesterday | today | last_7_days; method: debito | credito | pix · get_transactions — status: all | approved | declined; period (padrão last_7_days): yesterday | today | last_7_days · request_receivables_advance — method: debito | credito | pix · open_support_ticket — reason: sem_conexao | sem_sinal | erro_transacao | outro.

The system rule is Pix D+0, debit D+1 business day, and credit D+30 (next business day).

rows.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
rows.answer:
Your options are:

- **Get Conta:** This is a free digital account that lets you sell via Pix [sup-duvidas-42]. You can use it as the account that receives your sales, within 2 business days of the transaction and after your registration is complete [prod-ofertas-maquininha-13].
- **Another bank account:** If you aren't eligible for Get Conta, you can name another bank account in Getnet's digital channels. You stay eligible for the offer's discounts [prod-ofertas-maquininha-13].

Pix receipt time can vary by up to one calendar day. It depends on the Pix model you're eligible for and on the time the sale is approved [prod-pix-01].

The sources don't say whether you can receive Pix sales with no account at all. I can hand your case to a human agent if you'd like that confirmed.

O que é a Get Conta? Quais os benefícios?
É uma conta digital gratuita para sua empresa, sem burocracia e taxas escondidas, através de uma parceria com a Dock IP, você tem sua própria agência e conta.
Aqui, você pode:
Ter um cartão gratuito para realizar compras online ou físicas
Consegue enviar e receber dinheiro, além de vender por meio do Pix
Receber suas vendas em até 2 dias uteis no período da manhã no seu cartão*
Realizar transferências e pagamentos de contas
Efetuar saque em qualquer Banco 24Horas
*Caso escolha a opção de recebimento em dois dias depois da venda feita
Quem pode abrir uma Get Conta?

[policy:capabilities] Capabilities and action policy of this assistant (generated from the system's tool registry):
- Lookups the assistant runs immediately, only on the authenticated customer's data: get_settlements (Agenda de depósitos das vendas aprovadas do cliente autenticado: datas de depósito (dia útil), totais e contagens já calculados.); get_transactions (Vendas e recusas do cliente autenticado, com o significado do código de recusa, contagens e totais calculados.); get_terminal_status (Terminais do cliente autenticado: conexão, sinal, último contato e há quanto tempo está offline.).
- Actions the assistant can PROPOSE; nothing runs until the customer confirms the proposal: open_support_ticket (Abre chamado técnico para um terminal do cliente. Exige confirmação.).
- High-risk actions: they need the customer's confirmation AND then the approval of a human agent (operator) before they run: request_receivables_advance (Solicita antecipação dos recebíveis agendados. Exige confirmação do cliente e aprovação de um atendente.).
- An action proposal that is not confirmed expires after 15 minutes.
- Hand the case to a human agent: opens a case with a ticket number; the agent's reply shows up in this same conversation.
- A decision on an individual case (dispute, block or release of a held amount) belongs to a human agent; the assistant does not decide it.
- Apart from these tools, the assistant does not carry out any action in the system.
- Identifiers the lookups accept: transaction_id = Id da transação (ex.: TX1007) (ex.: TX0000); terminal_id = Id do terminal (ex.: T1988A) (ex.: T0000A).
- Values the lookups and actions accept (closed list: no other value is accepted): get_settlements — period (padrão yesterday): yesterday | today | last_7_days; method: debito | credito | pix · get_transactions — status: all | approved | declined; period (padrão last_7_days): yesterday | today | last_7_days · request_receivables_advance — method: debito | credito | pix · open_support_ticket — reason: sem_conexao | sem_sinal | erro_transacao | outro.

rows.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
replans: records:need->faq (terminal offline/sem sinal: o passo a passo vem do manual de conexão)
rows.answer:
Your terminal T1988B (Get Clássica) is the one that's offline. It connects by chip, shows no signal, and has been offline for 5 hours. Your other terminal, T1988A, is online.

For T1988B, the sources give these chip steps:
- Turn the machine off by pressing the "." key and the yellow key together for 2 seconds [sup-duvidas-66]. Then open the cover on the back [sup-duvidas-06].
- Put the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down [sup-duvidas-06].
- Close the cover and turn the machine on. Wait for the data network to connect [sup-duvidas-06].
- When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), it's ready to use. Then run a communication test [sup-duvidas-06].
- You can download the user manual for your model [sup-manual-maquinas-01].

I can propose a technical support ticket for T1988B with the reason "sem_sinal" or "sem_conexao". Nothing is opened until you confirm, and the proposal expires after 15 minutes. Do you want me to propose it?

The sources don't cover Wi-Fi setup, tips for improving signal, or the steps of the communication test. I can also hand your case to a human agent if you'd like.

A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. Você pode controlar o estoque, fazer pedidos, fechar conta, embarcar cardápio, emitir nota fiscal, tudo diretamente na máquina. A Get Smart permite que você integre o terminal com o sistema de seu estabelecimento e assim terá todos os aparelhos que seu negócio precisa em um único lugar.

rows.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
rows.answer:
You can advance your sales in the Getnet Brasil app, which is always available for that, and the app has no extra fees [sup-duvidas-17].

- **Automatic Advance (Antecipação Automática):** If you choose the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan, this is a condition for getting the exemption. It involves a credit approval process, and Getnet evaluates each contract individually to decide whether to grant it [sup-duvidas-102].
- **Through me:** I can propose a request to advance your scheduled receivables. You would have to confirm it, and then a human agent would have to approve it before it runs. Nothing has been requested yet.

The sources I found don't give the advance fee or rate, the payout timing, or the step-by-step process. A human agent can help with those if you'd like.

rows.message: My card machine is showing a transaction decline error.
replans: records:need->faq (transação recusada: a orientação vem do Knowledge; terminal offline/sem sinal: o)
rows.answer:
You have 2 declined transactions in the last 7 days (R$ 285,00 in total). Only one of them points to a terminal problem.

- **TX1007** (credit, R$ 210,00, terminal T1988A): code 51 means insufficient funds or credit limit on the customer's card. Ask for another card or payment method. T1988A is online with good signal, so this isn't a terminal problem.
- **TX1008** (debit, R$ 75,00, terminal T1988B): code 05 means the issuing bank did not authorize the transaction. The cardholder should contact their bank or try another card. T1988B is offline with no signal. It has been offline for 5 hours, and its last contact was 2026-11-03 23:18.

**Chip connection steps for T1988B** [sup-duvidas-06]:
1. Turn the machine off and open the back cover.
2. Insert the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down.
3. Close the cover, turn the machine on and wait for it to connect to the data network.
4. When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), it is ready to use.
5. Run a communication test to check the chip's connectivity.

The sources don't give Wi-Fi or other signal steps for an offline terminal.

I can propose a support ticket for T1988B (reason: sem_sinal). Nothing runs until you confirm, and the proposal expires after 15 minutes. Do you want me to propose it? I can also hand your case to a human agent.

[policy:capabilities] Capabilities and action policy of this assistant (generated from the system's tool registry):
- Lookups the assistant runs immediately, only on the authenticated customer's data: get_settlements (Agenda de depósitos das vendas aprovadas do cliente autenticado: datas de depósito (dia útil), totais e contagens já calculados.); get_transactions (Vendas e recusas do cliente autenticado, com o significado do código de recusa, contagens e totais calculados.); get_terminal_status (Terminais do cliente autenticado: conexão, sinal, último contato e há quanto tempo está offline.).
- Actions the assistant can PROPOSE; nothing runs until the customer confirms the proposal: open_support_ticket (Abre chamado técnico para um terminal do cliente. Exige confirmação.).
- High-risk actions: they need the customer's confirmation AND then the approval of a human agent (operator) before they run: request_receivables_advance (Solicita antecipação dos recebíveis agendados. Exige confirmação do cliente e aprovação de um atendente.).
- An action proposal that is not confirmed expires after 15 minutes.
- Hand the case to a human agent: opens a case with a ticket number; the agent's reply shows up in this same conversation.
- A decision on an individual case (dispute, block or release of a held amount) belongs to a human agent; the assistant does not decide it.
- Apart from these tools, the assistant does not carry out any action in the system.
- Identifiers the lookups accept: transaction_id = Id da transação (ex.: TX1007) (ex.: TX0000); terminal_id = Id do terminal (ex.: T1988A) (ex.: T0000A).
- Values the lookups and actions accept (closed list: no other value is accepted): get_settlements — period (padrão yesterday): yesterday | today | last_7_days; method: debito | credito | pix · get_transactions — status: all | approved | declined; period (padrão last_7_days): yesterday | today | last_7_days · request_receivables_advance — method: debito | credito | pix · open_support_ticket — reason: sem_conexao | sem_sinal | erro_transacao | outro.

rows.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
rows.answer:
With the Crediário, you can split a sale into up to 48 installments on a credit card [prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01]. Interest rates may vary depending on the card issuer [prod-crediario-03].

However many installments you choose, you receive the sale in a single payment within 2 business days after the transaction is captured. The discount fee (MDR) is deducted from that payment [sup-duvidas-39]. You can check your MDR in the Getnet Brasil app or the Customer Portal [prod-crediario-03].

Na Getnet, estão disponíveis as modalidades Parcelado Emissor e Parcelado Lojista.

rows.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
rows.answer:
Yes, you can sell through WhatsApp with the Payment Link. It's meant for WhatsApp, social media and remote charges, including if you don't have your own website. You create the link, send it to your customer, and receive the payment [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02].

- **Payment methods:** Customers can pay by card, Pix or debit [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02]. Another page also lists credit, Wallet and boleto [prod-link-de-pagamento-01].
- **Initial link:** R$1,00 per paid link. You pay only when the payment is approved [prod-link-de-pagamento-02].
- **Basic plan:** R$28 per month. It includes 60 card transactions per month, plus R$0,50 for each extra transaction [prod-link-de-pagamento-02].

rows.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
rows.answer:
The Get Clássica costs R$ 79,90/month and the Get Smart costs R$ 129,90/month [prod-ofertas-maquininha-11].

The Get Smart runs Android, so you can do more on the device itself. You can manage stock, take orders, close tabs, load a menu, issue invoices, and send messages between the kitchen and dining room [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-17]. It can also integrate with your business's system [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10]. It works as both a computer and a fiscal printer, so you don't need either at the counter [sup-duvidas-get-smart-08].

The sources don't describe the Get Clássica's features, and they don't say whether the rates differ between the two. If you'd like, I can pass you to a human agent to confirm those points.

rows.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
rows.answer:
You can receive Pix sales in the Get Conta, Getnet's free digital account for your business. With it you can send and receive money and sell through Pix [sup-duvidas-42]. You open it by choosing a machine and selecting to receive your sales in the account [sup-duvidas-44]. Some machine offers include "Get Conta com cartão grátis" under "Onde você recebe" [prod-get-tap-02]. Pix is received by generating a QR Code on physical terminals, TEF Auttar and Ecommerce [sup-duvidas-84].

The sources don't say whether you can receive Pix sales in an account at another bank, or whether an account is required. A human agent can confirm that for you if you'd like.

rows.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
replans: records:need->faq (terminal offline/sem sinal: o passo a passo vem do manual de conexão)
rows.answer:
Your Get Clássica (T1988B) is the terminal that's offline. It uses a chip, has no signal, and last made contact on 2026-11-03 at 23:20. Your other terminal, T1988A (Get Smart), is online on Wi-Fi with a good signal.

Steps for T1988B:
1. Turn the machine off and open the back cover. Insert the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, metal side facing down. [sup-duvidas-06]
2. Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for it to connect to the data network. When it shows 2G or 3G, it's ready to use. [sup-duvidas-06]
3. Run a communication test. Press the function button (F, # or the one on your machine), choose 2 (maintenance), then 1 (communication test). [sup-duvidas-07]

The machine uses a mobile-phone (GPRS) chip. The Chip Algar works anywhere with 2G/3G coverage. [prod-ofertas-maquininha-08][sup-duvidas-07] You can download the manual for your model from Getnet's manual page. [sup-manual-maquinas-01]

The sources don't give a specific fix for a terminal that is offline with no signal, and they don't cover Wi-Fi steps.

I can propose a support ticket for T1988B with the reason "sem_sinal". It is only a proposal, and nothing is opened until you confirm. I can also hand your case to a human agent. Which would you like?

A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. rows.answer:
You can advance your sales through the Getnet Brasil app, which is always available for this and has no extra fees [sup-duvidas-17].

- **Automatic Advance:** This is a condition for the exemption on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan. It involves a credit approval process. Getnet assesses each contract individually and may or may not grant it [sup-duvidas-102].
- **Through this assistant:** I can propose a request to advance your scheduled receivables. It only runs after you confirm and a human agent approves it.

The sources don't give the advance fee for the contract or the settlement timing, so I can't state either one. I can pass your case to a human agent if you'd like.

rows.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
rows.answer:
With the Crediário, you can split a sale into up to 48 installments on a credit card [prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01]. Interest rates may vary depending on the card issuer [prod-crediario-03].

No matter how many installments the cardholder chooses, you receive the payment in a single payment within 2 business days after the transaction is captured. The discount fee is subtracted from the original transaction amount [sup-duvidas-39].

To do this on the terminal, choose 1. CREDITO and enter the amount. Then select 4. CREDIARIO and enter the number of installments [prod-crediario-05].

Quais modalidades de Crédito Parcelado estão disponíveis na Getnet?
Na Getnet, estão disponíveis as modalidades Parcelado Emissor e Parcelado Lojista.

rows.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
rows.answer:
Yes, you can sell through WhatsApp with the Payment Link. It is meant for sales via WhatsApp, social networks and remote charges, including if you don't have your own website [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02]. You create a link and send it to your customer. They pay online by card, Pix or debit [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02].

To create a link:
1. Open the Minha Conta portal, using your login and password or the Getnet Brasil app.
2. Go to Products and Services, choose Payment Link, then Create Payment Link.
3. Fill in the product, shipping and payment options.
4. Click share or copy, then send the link wherever you like [prod-link-de-pagamento-04].

rows.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
rows.answer:
The two machines differ in price and features. The Get Clássica costs R$ 79,90/month and the Get Smart costs R$ 129,90/month [prod-ofertas-maquininha-11].

The Get Smart is an Android smart card machine. On the device you can control stock, take orders, close tabs, load a menu and issue invoices [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-17]. It can integrate with your business system and can replace a computer and fiscal printer at the counter [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-08]. It also supports messaging between kitchen and floor [sup-duvidas-get-smart-17].

The sources don't describe the Get Clássica's features, so I can't give a feature-by-feature comparison. I can pass your question to a human agent if you'd like.

A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. Você pode controlar o estoque, fazer pedidos, fechar conta, embarcar cardápio, emitir nota fiscal, tudo diretamente na máquina. Quais os diferenciais de uma Get Smart?
Com um sistema de gestão integrado ele permite que não tenha a necessidade de deslocamento para consultar um estoque, o mesmo pode ser consultado diretamente na máquina. Ele permite um balcão mais limpo, onde não é necessário ter um computador e uma impressora fiscal, ele faz ambas funções. Ele permite mais rapidez no atendimento diminuindo o tempo de espera do cliente, você pode fazer o pedido, fechar a conta e emitir o cupom fiscal tudo diretamente no terminal. Com ele você tem uma conciliação com pagamentos em todas modalidades, crédito, debito, crediário, QR Code ou dinheiro. Os sistemas de gestão homologados possuem conciliação completa.

rows.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
rows.answer:
Yes, in practice you do. To sign up for Pix at Getnet, you must give one Pix key linked to the account where you want to receive your sales. If your bank account has more than one key, choose one to give to Getnet [sup-duvidas-81].

The sources don't say which account types are accepted. They also don't say whether a Getnet account (Get Conta) can be used. I can pass your case to a human agent if you'd like.

rows.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
replans: records:need->faq (terminal offline/sem sinal: o passo a passo vem do manual de conexão)
rows.answer:
Your terminal T1988B (Get Clássica, chip) is offline with no signal. It last made contact at 2026-11-03 23:23, about 5 hours ago. Your other terminal, T1988A, is online with a good signal.

Steps for T1988B from the manuals:
1. Turn the machine off. Press the "." key and the yellow key together for 2 seconds, depending on your model [sup-duvidas-66].
2. Open the back cover and check that the chip is in its slot, marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal part facing down [sup-duvidas-06].
3. Close the cover and turn the machine on. On some models you press the green key. Wait for it to connect to the data network [sup-duvidas-06][sup-duvidas-66].
4. When it shows a network (2G or 3G), it is ready to use. Run a communication test to check that the chip is connecting [sup-duvidas-06].

The sources don't give the steps for the communication test. They also don't say what to do if the signal doesn't come back.

O que é a Get Smart?
A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. Você pode controlar o estoque, fazer pedidos, fechar conta, embarcar cardápio, emitir nota fiscal, tudo diretamente na máquina. A Get Smart permite que você integre o terminal com o sistema de seu estabelecimento e assim terá todos os aparelhos que seu negócio precisa em um único lugar.

rows.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
rows.answer:
You can advance your sales through the Getnet Brasil app, and the app has no extra fees [sup-duvidas-17].

- **Automatic Advance:** Customers on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" plan need it to get the exemption. It involves credit approval, and Getnet assesses each contract individually [sup-duvidas-102].
- **Financial Reserve:** This is a separate mechanism. It holds back part of what you receive as protection against financial setbacks, and it doesn't affect your sales volume [sup-antecipacao-04]. The amount is released on the originally scheduled date, unless it was used to cover cancellations, chargebacks, terminal rental or other expenses. If the release is early, you get an email [sup-antecipacao-02].
- **Through me:** I can propose an advance of your scheduled receivables. It only runs after you confirm it and a human agent approves it.

The sources don't give the rate, the timing or how the amount is calculated. A human agent can help with those if you'd like.

rows.answer:
The one terminal problem is that T1988B is offline.

I found 2 declined sales yesterday (2026-11-03), totaling R$ 285,00:
- **TX1007** (credit, R$ 210,00, T1988A): code 51 means insufficient funds or credit limit on the customer's card. Ask for another card or payment method. T1988A is online with good Wi-Fi signal.
- **TX1008** (debit, R$ 75,00, T1988B): code 05 means the issuing bank did not authorize it (generic). The cardholder should contact their bank or try another card.

T1988B has no signal and has been offline for 5 hours. Its last contact was 2026-11-03 23:23.

I can propose a support ticket for T1988B with the reason "sem_sinal". Nothing happens until you confirm, and the proposal expires after 15 minutes. Would you like me to do that?

I found no connection troubleshooting guide for the machine, so I can't give you steps for that. I can also pass your case to a human agent if you want.

rows.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
rows.answer:
You can split a sale into up to 48 installments with the Crediário on a credit card [prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01]. Interest rates can vary depending on the card issuer [prod-crediario-03].

- **On the terminal:** choose option 1 (CREDITO), then option 4 (CREDIARIO), and enter the number of installments [prod-crediario-05].
- **Simulation:** you can run one before the sale. It shows the value of all installments and charges [prod-crediario-01].
- **Payment to you:** you receive Crediário sales in a single payment, within 2 business days after the transaction is captured, whatever the number of installments. The discount fee (MDR) is subtracted from the original transaction amount [sup-duvidas-39].

rows.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
rows.answer:
Yes. The Payment Link is meant for selling over WhatsApp, social media and remote charges. It also works for businesses that don't have their own website [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02]. Your customer can pay online by card, Pix or debit [prod-pagamentos-pelo-whatsapp-02].

To create a link:
1. Open the Minha Conta portal.
2. Go to Products and Services, then Payment Link, then Create Payment Link.
3. Fill in the product, shipping and payment options.
4. Click share or copy, then send the link wherever you want [prod-link-de-pagamento-04].

failures.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
failures.answer:
The Get Smart costs more and does more. It's R$ 129,90/month, against R$ 79,90/month for the Get Clássica [prod-ofertas-maquininha-11][prod-todas-as-maquininhas-04].

The Get Smart is a smart card machine that runs Android. It works as both a computer and a fiscal printer. On the device you can:
- manage stock
- take orders
- close the bill
- load a menu
- issue fiscal receipts
- exchange messages between kitchen and floor
- reconcile payments in all methods

Sources: [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-17][sup-duvidas-get-smart-08].

The sources don't describe the Get Clássica's features, so I can't compare the two feature by feature. I can pass you to a human agent if you want more detail.

O que é a Get Smart?
A Get Smart é uma máquina de cartões inteligente. Com ela, seu dia a dia fica mais simples, fácil e muito mais digital. Você pode controlar o estoque, fazer pedidos, fechar conta, embarcar cardápio, emitir nota fiscal, tudo diretamente na máquina. A Get Smart permite que você integre o terminal com o sistema de seu estabelecimento e assim terá todos os aparelhos que seu negócio precisa em um único lugar.

Quais os diferenciais de uma Get Smart?
Com um sistema de gestão integrado ele permite que não tenha a necessidade de deslocamento para consultar um estoque, o mesmo pode ser consultado diretamente na máquina. Ele permite um balcão mais limpo, onde não é necessário ter um computador e uma impressora fiscal, ele faz ambas funções. Ele permite mais rapidez no atendimento diminuindo o tempo de espera do cliente, você pode fazer o pedido, fechar a conta e emitir o cupom fiscal tudo diretamente no terminal. Com ele você tem uma conciliação com pagamentos em todas modalidades, crédito, debito, crediário, QR Code ou dinheiro. Os sistemas de gestão homologados possuem conciliação completa.

failures.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
failures.answer:
The two machines differ in price and features. The Get Clássica costs R$ 79,90/month and the Get Smart costs R$ 129,90/month [prod-ofertas-maquininha-11].

The Get Smart is an Android smart card machine. On the device you can control stock, take orders, close tabs, load a menu and issue invoices [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-17]. It can integrate with your business system and can replace a computer and fiscal printer at the counter [sup-duvidas-get-smart-10][sup-duvidas-get-smart-08]. It also supports messaging between kitchen and floor [sup-duvidas-get-smart-17].

The sources don't describe the Get Clássica's features, so I can't give a feature-by-feature comparison. I can pass your question to a human agent if you'd like.
